decisions.reason: Featured on the home page and building on core messaging expertise, this transactional email option shows strong early commitment, and its upside is still uncertain enough to keep it open at low cost.
Its dedicated page signals investment, and its value in electronic document workflows is still unresolved, so keeping this option open is cheaper than abandoning it after one year.
Email and fax conversion runs on existing infrastructure, so its holding cost is minimal while it serves regulated customers who still rely on fax.
A delivery optimization feature close to the core fax service costs almost nothing to maintain, so there is no reason to give up the option.
Sandbox threat protection addresses growing security demand, and its prospects are uncertain but promising, which justifies keeping the option open.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a low-cost extension of the security portfolio, and no results so far indicate that its value is unlikely to be realized.
